title: symphyotrichum × finkii
intro: Symphyotrichum × finkii, commonly known as Fink's aster, is a hybrid plant species in the family Asteraceae, resulting from the cross between Symphyotrichum novi-belgii and Symphyotrichum puniceum. This plant has been used for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in soothing skin irritations and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Fink's aster are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Symphyotrichum × finkii include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
